raw: {"findings": [{"category": "count-repetition", "severity": "blocking", "where": "front face, left and right of the central latch", "evidence": "Two extra hinge-style iron straps with knuckle barrels sit on the front, so the chest has four hinges instead of the two back-edge hinges and one latch the spec calls for."}, {"category": "construction", "severity": "blocking", "where": "front left and front right hinge straps across the lid seam", "evidence": "Knuckled hinges bridge the lid and body on the front while hinges also sit on the back edge, so a lid hinged on both front and back could not open."}], "verdict": "fail"}

findings.where: front face, left and right of the central latch
findings.evidence: Two extra hinge-style iron straps with knuckle barrels sit on the front, so the chest has four hinges instead of the two back-edge hinges and one latch the spec calls for.

findings.where: front left and front right hinge straps across the lid seam
findings.evidence: Knuckled hinges bridge the lid and body on the front while hinges also sit on the back edge, so a lid hinged on both front and back could not open.
